rationale: dual_domain-claude-agentic: epochs=50, lr=0.0001, batch_size=1, unet_c=24, train_n=50, val_n=5, rationale=iter-8: KNOB=epochs: 30→50 + lr 5e-3→1e-4 (different family: LONG patient training). iter-1..7 swept c, lr ∈ {5e-5..5e-3}, batch=1/4, all stuck SSIM 0.46-0.47. Hypothesis: aggressive lr can't break N2I noise floor; conservative long-training (50 ep at 1e-4) may eventually distill clean signal — test the OPPOSITE optimizer regime.
